summary.title: Investigating missing settings key for rate in pricing.py
summary.body: The missing key is `rate`. `settings.json` has a typo: the key is spelled `"rat"` (value `0.5`), so `SETTINGS.get("rate")` returns `None`. Renaming `"rat"` to `"rate"` in `settings.json` would fix it. I haven't changed any files.
